correctness.rationale: The exact factorization s_{-3}(p^e)=∑_{j≤e}(-p^{-3})^j reduces the infinite range closure to 135 intervals. For p≥11, five exact finite products plus Nagura for p≥29 prove logarithmic tail dominance, hence squarefree tail closure [T,1]. Local exponent dominance and interval overlaps are certified with rational upper T bound. The complete union and its 18 strict gaps are certified by rigorous rational zeta bounds T_-≤T≤T_+; the verifier directly reproduces all 135 scales, 19 components and endpoints. No finite enumeration is used as a surrogate for the infinite tail theorem.
